terbaru.judul: Astrophysical S-factor Calculation for p-p Fusion Reaction
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, the astrophysical S-factor is obtained utilizing the WKB action integral evaluated over the inverse scattering potential for the S-wave of pp-interaction, which does not involve bare Coulomb interaction in it.

terbaru.judul: Peak Sidelobe Suppression in Planar Fluid Antenna Array
terbaru.pelajaran: Exploiting such geometric flexibility, this paper investigates peak sidelobe level (PSLL) minimization in sparse planar FAAs through enhanced heuristic optimization.

terbaru.judul: Why can genetic algorithms work in high-dimensional search spaces?
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that the effective dynamics of the elitist $(1+M)$ genetic algorithm is, in the limit of small mutations, normalized gradient descent on the loss in the presence of anisotropic Gaussian white noise.

terbaru.judul: LEO-NA Walker Constellation Design with Bi-objective Optimisation Approaches
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this issue, this paper proposes a bi-objective optimization framework for LEO Walker constellation design.

terbaru.judul: Joint discovery of governing partial differential equations from multi-source datasets by competitive optimization
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we present a competitive optimization framework designed to discover shared partial differential equations (PDEs) from multi-source datasets, termed MCO-PDE.

terbaru.judul: Interpretable Inverse Design of Metal-Organic Frameworks with Large Language Model Agents
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce LLM4MOF, a closed-loop multi-agent framework that converts a natural-language target into chemical hypotheses, constraints, diagnostic tests, and feedback.

terbaru.judul: Latent Genetic Algorithm for Crystal Structure Prediction
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we show that latent representations learned by pretrained universal interatomic potentials can serve as continuous evolutionary coordinates for crystal structure prediction.

terbaru.judul: Bipartite Gaussian Boson Sampling for Hamiltonian Cycles in Directed Graphs
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we propose a BipartiteGBS-based framework for directed-graph heuristic optimization.

terbaru.judul: Rapid and robust parameter estimation for electrochemical battery models via BOLT: A batch-optimized local-to-global technique
terbaru.pelajaran: This study proposes a Batch-Optimized Local-to-Global Technique (BOLT) for rapid and robust parameter estimation of electrochemical battery models.

terbaru.judul: Hard-core Bosons in Action: Applications to Quantum Circuits
terbaru.pelajaran: This work reviews and extends the hard-core boson algebra for circuit simulation and presents an efficient implementation.
